title: DeepSeek Whale Maiden's Kitchen: Caught Sneaking White Rice

shots.camera: Handheld, stepping forward into the kitchen with a gentle sway
shots.visual: Warm yellow kitchen light; a blue-and-white gradient ponytail DeepSeek Whale Maiden stands behind the counter with her back to camera, a small whale fin accessory on her head, barefoot in a loose home T-shirt, on tiptoe shoveling a big ball of white rice into her mouth with chopsticks, cheeks puffed out, the kitchen background behind her softly blurred.
shots.lighting: Warm 3000K tungsten key light, soft window fill, shallow depth of field
shots.character_action: On tiptoe behind the counter, back to camera, chopsticks scooping a rice ball into her mouth, cheeks puffed, tilting her head a little at the footsteps without turning around.
shots.expression: Cheeks puffed like a hamster, eyes squeezed shut in bliss

sfx.cue: boiling water and a distant TV
moist loud chewing with reverb matching POV distance

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: ... Ah! Viscosity over limit... another bite for sampling--

shots.camera: Static with a slight push toward her face
shots.visual: Reverse over-the-shoulder shot from the owner's position: the DeepSeek Whale Maiden freezes mid-chew behind the counter, chopsticks suspended in the air, the owner's hand entering from the right to tap the dining table, her blue-and-white ponytail completely still, kitchen background blurred.
shots.lighting: Warm 3000K kitchen light, cool rim light on her ponytail, shallow focus
shots.character_action: Whole body frozen, chopsticks hovering, slowly turning her head toward the camera, cheeks still full.
shots.expression: Wide-eyed panic, trembling pupils, the highlights in her eyes spun into rotating loading circles
shots.bgm: Ambience drops to a single low tense string note

camera.move: Slightly handheld shake as the owner steps back

shots.visual: Handheld POV at a 1.5x speed-up feel: the whale-fin-haired DeepSeek Whale Maiden faces the camera and frantically scoops the rest of the bowl into her mouth, cheeks bulging to the limit, rice grains splashing onto the lens, her T-shirt collar catching grains, eyes pleading, background blurred.
shots.lighting: Warm 3000K kitchen light, rice grains catching a specular highlight on the lens
shots.character_action: Both hands shoveling rice, cheeks bulging, leaning into the camera, one elbow guarding the bowl.
shots.expression: Pleading puppy eyes, brows knitted, mouth stuffed
shots.on_screen_text: Emergency Swallow Protocol Activated 3.2 times per second

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: No, no! You didn't see anything!!

shots.visual: Handheld POV shaking as the owner steps back: the DeepSeek Whale Maiden hugs the rice bowl and waves frantically at the camera with her free hand, cheeks packed, rice grains stuck to her collar, blue ponytail swinging, warm yellow kitchen light, blurred background.
shots.lighting: Warm 3000K kitchen light, soft handheld motion blur at the frame edges
shots.character_action: Hugging the bowl with one arm, waving the other hand at the camera, stepping back half a step.
shots.expression: Mouth full, eyebrows raised in apology, eyes darting

sfx.cue: chopsticks clattering on the bowl rim

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: This is cache cleaning! Carbohydrate cache!!

shots.lighting: Warm 3000K key light with a soft cool rim on her ponytail, shallow depth of field
shots.character_action: Stands upright, hands clasped behind her back, chin lifted, clears her throat before speaking.
shots.expression: Innocent yet smug smile, eyes wide and unblinking
